name: channel-import-outcome
description: Per-event outcomes of one connection's progressive initial history import (backlog:66282d13d81c). One row per (import, provider event): whether the event stored a new inbox row, was already present, or failed, plus its sender reconciliation. Rows are written once and never tallied by hand — the progress surface counts them (one COUNT per state), so racing advances and crash retries converge to the same numbers as a clean run, because the number is always the rows themselves. importKey references the channel-import-state row's sourceKey.
